chat_adapter: crit_core.serving.ResidentChat with tool_format gemma_tools.GEMMA_CALL; sampling fields temperature, top_p, top_k (<= 64), seed
decode_activations: bf16 GEMV inputs, fp32 accumulation and residual stream
drafter_weights: google/gemma-4-31B-it-assistant BF16 re-encoded to NVFP4 at load (per-tensor global scale, E4M3 block scales of 16); draft-only
kv_cache: fp8 e4m3, one fp32 scale per (position, kv head); sliding layers: K and V in a 3,200-slot ring; full layers: u = v_norm(k) plus the 128 rotated key dims RoPE(u * w) as their own E4M3 codes and scale
prompt_activations: attention projections FP8 E4M3 per row; MLP NVFP4 with a per-row global scale (448*6/row amax) and E4M3 block scales of 16; fp32 accumulation and residual stream
weights: transformed: attention q/k/v/o projections and the tied output head re-encoded from BF16 to FP8 E4M3 per row (scale = row amax / 448, round to nearest even, saturating) at load; NVFP4 MLPs (ModelOpt weight, weight_scale, weight_scale_2, input_scale) and BF16 norms, layer scalars and embedding rows as stored
